newsitem.title: USA: Travelers 401(k) option plan questioned - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Travelers 401(k) option plan questioned - WSJ.

text.p: The Internal Revenue Service is reconsidering a ruling which would have let Travelers Group Inc contribute Travelers stock options to its employees' 401(k) plans, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
The paper said the agency declined to comment but cited a government official as saying the IRS was rethinking its private-letter ruling issued on March 21.
The U.S. Labour Department, which was expected to decide on the matter by the end of March, had also not made up its mind on the plan, the newspaper said.
A Labour Department spokeswoman was quoted as saying: "Some concerns have been raised and the Labour Department is considering them."
Travelers was not immediately available to comment.
